title: Added keyboard shortcuts modal
summary: Launched quick navigation shortcuts and a modal so power users can jump between sections without reaching for the mouse.
body: Introduced KeyboardNav modal with `?` shortcut, added instant navigation combos (`g h`, `g b`, `g p`) and `t` to toggle color theme.

title: Launched dynamic bookmarks page
summary: Hooked the site to Karakeep so freshly saved resources sync straight into a new bookmarks gallery.
body: Built `/bookmarks` with live Karakeep API data and smart caching headers, added category sections mapped to reading lists.

title: Astro upgrade & performance audit
summary: Upgraded Astro and tightened build tooling which shaved ~12% off bundle size.
body: Bumped Astro to latest minor, regenerated lockfile, added automatic link hover effects and smoother page transitions.
